commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' 2 - 1 GOAL! Jesus Vallejo meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Jacobo Ramon (Real Madrid) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:1.
